title: Advancing Mass-Conserving Deep Learning for Distributed Hydrologic Modeling: A Case Study in a Snow-Dominated Watershed
abstract: arXiv:2611.13346v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent progress in physics-aware deep learning (DL) has embedded mass conservation within Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture for hydrologic modeling, improving physical consistency and enabling diagnostics of internal states. However, existing mass-conserving neural networks are primarily developed in lumped formulations. Consequently, previous studies provide only fragmented and often indirect evidence of when and why imposed physical constraints may lead to unrealistic hydrologic behavior. To address this limitation, we propose Physics-Enhanced Conservation-Augmented Net (PECAN), a mass-conserving convolutional LSTM-based framework for distributed hydrologic modeling and diagnosing structural limitations of physics-aware DL models. PECAN is implemented in two variants: (1) PECAN-MC with a strict precipitation-based conservation constraint and (2) PECAN-MCR with a relaxed conservation constraint allowing additional water inputs

translated_title: 推进用于分布式水文建模的质量守恒深度学习：以一个积雪主导流域为例
translated_abstract: 物理感知深度学习（DL）的最新进展已将质量守恒嵌入到用于水文建模的长短期记忆网络（LSTM）架构中，提升了物理一致性，并支持对内部状态的诊断。然而，现有的质量守恒神经网络主要以集总式（lumped）形式开发。因此，以往的研究仅提供了零散且往往间接的证据，说明施加的物理约束在何时以及为何可能导致不合理的水文行为。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了物理增强守恒增广网络（PECAN），这是一个基于质量守恒卷积LSTM的框架，可用于分布式水文建模以及诊断物理感知深度学习模型的结构性局限。PECAN以两种变体实现：(1) PECAN-MC，具有严格的基于降水的守恒约束；(2) PECAN-MCR，具有放宽的守恒约束，允许额外的水分输入。
tldr: 本文提出了一个质量守恒的卷积LSTM框架PECAN，通过严格（PECAN-MC）和放宽（PECAN-MCR）两种守恒约束变体实现分布式水文建模，并用于诊断物理感知深度学习模型的结构性局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PECAN, a mass-conserving convolutional LSTM framework for distributed hydrologic modeling, implemented in two variants with strict (PECAN-MC) and relaxed (PECAN-MCR) conservation constraints to diagnose structural limitations of physics-aware deep learning models.
